title: Write a fraction as a decimal

divide.name: Divide
divide.idea: Divide the numerator by the denominator (long division or a calculator).

power_of_ten.name: Scale to 10, 100, 1000
power_of_ten.idea: Multiply top and bottom so the denominator becomes 10, 100, or 1000, then read off the decimal.
power_of_ten.best_when: The denominator only has factors 2 and 5 (2, 4, 5, 8, 20, 25, …).
power_of_ten.watch_out: Impossible when the denominator has another prime factor (3, 7, …).
